identity:
Completing this mission will instantly build a new structure on your home island.

Craft the Mouth of the Island from simple tools and common building materials.  The Heart of the Island has already placed the recipe inside your mind.

New Structure: Bunker Entrance.  A simple concrete entrance leading down into the lower levels of the island, including a small subterranean chamber.

identity:
It has happened so many times.  A new recruit thinks they can beat fire with fire and goes past the point of no return.  When it happens, they either become another vampire or a killer of hunters.

For everyone's sake, I won't let you go down that path no matter what I must do.

identity: This vampire was a lesser one, as seen by their resistance to the sun and lack of proper lair.  One day you will attack the lairs of true vampires alongside some of our hunters, but first we must find where they truly hide.  For now, we can enjoy some peace of mind and you can ask Elsa and Blaine for spare things to help you like you helped us.
